description: Resolve a product NAME to its ShelfAtlas id and EAN — use this BEFORE calling find_cheapest_offers or search_catalog_offers when you only have a product name (e.g. from a user question) and not an id or barcode. Matches on the canonical product name, case-insensitive, substring match. Returns id, name, ean (null for self-serve keys — every EAN is Salling-sourced and restricted to partner keys), and size (volumeMl/unitCount/quantityUnit) where known.

q.description: Product name (or part of it) to search for, e.g. "Pepsi Max 50cl". Minimum 2 characters.

name: search_products
